findings.finding: The proposed change ('Stored analysis records unavailable on this page') is less precise than the source. The source text ('Analysis records are not shown here') clearly matches the page function and avoids implying records exist and are just 'unavailable' (which could be misleading for staff). The replacement edits away the neutral and factual characterization. The original must be kept for accuracy.

Expanding the prohibition to include 'export' ('Staff cannot view or export analysis records from this page') reasonably matches the intent of the in-code comment (get/export is fail-closed). However, the source only says 'Staff cannot open stored analysis records.' including only opening/reading, so this addition is accurate in practical scope, but goes beyond the page's exact source text. Acceptable if the in-code comment is part of the approved official surface.
The edit rephrases but does not materially change the meaning: both versions direct staff to the example in the Toolkit for process review. No loss of source intent or accuracy.
